Frequently asked questions about Ford truck parts

Answers about identifying parts, requesting quotes and sourcing parts for Ford Trucks.

Request a quote

FAQ

Do you only supply parts for Cargo and F-MAX?

We supply parts on request for the whole range of Ford Trucks rigid trucks and tractor units: Cargo, F-MAX, F-LINE and vehicles for haulage, construction and special applications. Depending on the part number, parts come from stock or are sourced for you; availability and lead time are confirmed in the quote.

Can you source parts for truck bodies?

On request we can also source parts for equipment mounted on the truck: refuse compactors, water or fuel tanks, pumps and other bodies. The body is often made by a manufacturer other than Ford, so we identify the part by the equipment's make, model, serial number and documentation.

How do I identify a part without a number?

Send the VIN and a description of the part. For mounted equipment, also send the body manufacturer's details.

How do I send a request?

Use the form, call us or write on WhatsApp. The form sends your request to us by e-mail; you can also send it through WhatsApp.

How do I pay?

By bank transfer or cash, under the terms confirmed in the quote. We do not take online payments on this site.

How long does sourcing take?

For most parts the usual range is 12–48 hours. Availability and the actual lead time are confirmed in the quote.
